blocks.text: Lortab addiction is a condition wherein a person makes use of the drug for prolonged period of time (may be several weeks or longer). If such thin happens, mental and physical dependence usually takes place and this is due to the sense of wellbeing attained by the user. When a person is addicted to Lortab, he will soon get multiple prescriptions from different doctors so as to support his uncontrolled cravings.

blocks.text: This is difficult on the part of the user because Lortab is known to activate the reward system of the brain. The brain’s reward system with Lortab is so intense, focusing one’s attention around obtaining and taking the drug. Lortab has the ability to activate a person’s brain reward mechanism, thereby causing addiction in the process. This kind of drug also reduces one’s level of consciousness, making a person impaired and unable to make himself fully aware of what is going on around him.

blocks.text: Lortab is a kind of drug which is also known as hydrocodone, a medical prescription drug which is used for medical purposes. When taken, Lortab combines a painkiller (narcotic analgesic) and cough remedy with non-narcotic analgesic to treat moderate to severe pains. When induced, a person may experience a dangerous level of sedation, drowsiness and dizziness.

blocks.text: So, what happens when a person strives to stop using Lortab? If a regular user stops his consumption of the drug. He will automatically experience withdrawal symptoms within 6 to 12 hours. While these symptoms are not known to be life-threatening, the intensity one might feel may not be a good experience.
